meaning: Finite one-world interpretations; excluded middle is not asserted. With two ungrounded candidates, a flat q3 profile (every being in act, nothing caused, represented esse equal to essence) and no priority or composition, the seven non-logical inputs hold and both roots are unlimited: if every determination is non-pure, the bridge and strict pure actuality at the roots fail; if every determination is pure, both hold. With one candidate grounding the other, strict pure actuality at the roots holds while the bridge fails at the unlimited non-root, so the bridge ranges beyond what the roots need. With a single first mover that is simple and first in being, a non-pure determination makes the bridge and strict pure actuality for first movers fail. Satisfiability of encoded bundles, not metaphysical possibility.
